decisions.description: Is a practice account being created alongside this one? If so the account just created is by definition the corporate parent, and that is worth stamping while we know it for certain. With the toggle off the flow cannot tell a corporate from a standalone practice, so nothing is stamped and Account_Level__c stays blank.

Flow.description: Utility Bar Screen Flow to create a new Account, with non-blocking duplicate detection (promoted from Dedupe Option 3 — PRO-860). The Account Name field is a custom LWC (c:accountDedupeCombo) that searches existing Accounts as you type (SOSL via AccountDedupeSearch): pick an existing match to open it via a View Account button (no record created), or type a new name to create. Captures Website, Parent, Type, Associated with Specialist, Existing Scanners, and Shipping/Billing addresses with a Billing Same As Shipping toggle, plus optional Contact. 2026-09-01: AP - Website ownership split to stop the corporate/practice mirror pattern regenerating (OPS-202 / AHI 3b). The screen input now lands in Group_Website__c on the corporate record and is copied into Website on the practice, so exactly one record holds the domain that Front and HubSpot match on. Both the manual (Prepare_Practice_Account) and automatic (Prepare_Practice_Account_Auto) paths were changed - previously each wrote the same value to Website on both records. 2026-09-14: AP - Added corpAccountName formula, wired into Stamp_Corporate_Level, to append " - Corp" to the corporate account's Name at creation per the OPS-180 naming convention. 2026-09-15: AP - Fixed "- Corp" leaking onto the practice account: Prepare_Practice_Account_Auto now sources the practice Name from SmartName.accountName instead of varNewAccount.Name, which had already been stamped with the corp suffix (OPS-180). 2026-09-29: AP - Fixed "- Corp" leaking onto the practice account via the manual path too: Practice_Account_Details screen's practiceName field now defaults from SmartName.accountName instead of varNewAccount.Name (which is already stamped with the corp suffix by this point), matching the same fix already applied to Prepare_Practice_Account_Auto on 2026-09-15 (OPS-180). 2026-10-20: AP - OPS-461: Removed the Straumann Customer Number field from the Account_Details screen, and removed the two assignments that copied it onto the practice account (Prepare_Practice_Account_Auto and Prepare_Practice_Account), since it is no longer collected here. Reps add it later on the account. Nothing else changed.

formulas.description: The account a newly created Contact belongs to. When the rep asked for a practice account to be created, the contact belongs to the practice - that is where the person actually works. With no practice, it stays on the corporate account as before. Safe on both paths into Contact_to_be_Created, because varPracticeAccount.Id is only referenced when the toggle that creates it was on.

formulas.description: Matches the OPS-180 "- Corp" naming convention applied elsewhere to existing accounts. Guards against double-suffixing if the rep already typed " - Corp" themselves.
